Section I
Executive discussion topics

The conversations are designed for decisions, not demos.

Leaders compare what they have already done, what they are building now, and which operating choices will determine whether AI creates measurable value. The room is built for exchange between operators who carry the accountability, not for vendors seeking a stage.
